body: Ang overlooked signal dito: recovery scam is not merely ‘same scam, second round.’ Mas dangerous ang structure dahil may prior victim history na puwedeng gawing credibility hook. Kaya evidence standard should actually rise after a loss, not fall: independently verify the organization, contact it through a channel you found yourself, and treat any request for fresh money to unlock old money as a major red flag. Maganda ang hope/prudence framing, pero operational test pa rin ang pinakamalakas na antidote sa persuasive story.

claims.text: A prior loss can give a recovery scammer a more tailored credibility hook, so verification standards should increase rather than decrease.
claims.basis: Inference from the CAA-described secondary-scam pattern in the article
